descriptionChirho: The proper noun Shebaniah (also Shevanyahu, Shevanyah), a Levitical name borne by several individuals in post-exilic Judah, including priests and Levites who participated in covenant renewal ceremonies (Neh 9:4-5, 10:4, 10:10, 10:12) and a priestly trumpeter at David's ark procession (1 Chr 15:24). All three sense clusters represent the same personal name in different syntactic frames: standalone (5x), with conjunctive waw 'and-Shebaniah' (1x), and with preposition lamed 'to-Shebaniah' (1x). Multilingual translations confirm identity: Spanish 'Sebanias,' Arabic 'shabanya,' Hindi 'shabanyah/shabanyahu,' Korean 'swebanya/seubanaya,' Swahili 'Shebania/Shebaniya/Shebanya.'
